name: EQT AB (publ)
summary: EQT AB (publ) is a global private equity & venture capital firm specializing in private capital and real asset segments. The firm seeks to invest in seed, startup, turnaround, middle market, mature, early venture, emerging growth, mid venture, late venture, distressed/vulture, loan, secondary (direct) investments. The firm seeks to invest through growth, buyout and recapitalization in companies. It also invests in green fund & fintech investments.
